verdict.rationale: AMD documents SDK-level APIs (ONNX Runtime C++/Python inference sessions, a server interface enabling C#, JavaScript, Python, C++ integration with Ryzen AI LLMs, and Python/C++ device-detection APIs), which let developers programmatically drive the NPU/GPU stack. However there is no evidence of a formal public REST/OpenAPI-style API (probe attempts for openapi.json/swagger.json all 404), so 'public API' here means local SDK bindings rather than a hosted documented API surface. Missing for 10: a formal REST/OpenAPI spec or hosted API documentation, and independent confirmation of API stability/versioning.
